integrity: The proof is analytic. Numerical checks are supplementary and do not establish the theorem. The source's existence, uniqueness, stability, and comparative-statics statements are not re-assessed beyond what is needed for this corrected enclosure.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the convex one-dimensional adaptive-dynamics regime.
The explicit slope bound can be weaker than the endpoint bound p_*; the implicit chord bound remains valid and may be sharper.
No claim is made about the nonconvex multi-equilibrium examples beyond the invalidity of the printed derivative-inverse endpoint under the convex theorem's assumptions.
title: A valid equilibrium enclosure replaces an undefined derivative-inverse bound in an adaptive vaccination game
